1.w: For the one directing. Of David. For remembrance. O God, deliver me, O YHWH, may You hurry—to help me!

2.w: Let them be ashamed and confounded, those seeking my soul; let them be turned back and be disgraced, those taking delight [in] my harm!

3.w: Let them be turned back over the heel of their shame, those saying, “Aha, aha!”

4.w: Let all those seeking You rejoice and be glad in You; those loving Your salvation, let them say continually “May God be magnified!”

5.w: And I [am] lowly and needy; O God, hurry to me! You [are] my help and my deliverer, O YHWH—do not delay!
